# Welcome

Welcome to the course website for **Fluid Dynamics and Cell Mechanics**, part of the **Mesoscale and Biological Physics** unit.

::: {.callout-note}
This website brings together the teaching materials, lecture notes, practical exercises, and learning resources used throughout the course.
:::

## What you will find here

- Lecture notes and supplementary reading material
- Practical exercises and laboratory activities


## About this website

This site is built using **Quarto** and is automatically published through **GitHub Pages**, ensuring that the most up-to-date course materials are always available online.

## Navigation

Use the chapter thumbnails in the top-left navigation panel to browse the different sections of the course.

We recommend working through the notes in order, as later chapters build on concepts introduced earlier in the module.

::: {.callout-tip}
If this is your first visit, start with the introductory chapter before moving on to the lecture notes and practical activities.
:::
